cues.zh: 很久以前，但也没那么久
cues.en: - A long time ago, but not long enough ago
that it's not still very relevant
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 英国所有人都上了一艘大旧船，
cues.en: everyone in Britain got in a big old boat,

cues.zh: 我们扬帆起航，四处抢劫，
cues.en: and we set sail and we robbed,
and this will sound far-fetched,
everyone in the world.
(audience laughs)
Do you remember that?
What a spree that was?
Do you remember the great heist?
What a spree.
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 我们弄到了所有这些赃物，对吧？
cues.en: And we got all this swag didn't we?
And we took it back to old blighty

cues.zh: 然后藏了起来，这才是高明之处，
cues.en: and we hid it, this is the clever part,

cues.zh: 我们把它藏进了一家博物馆。
cues.en: we hid it in a museum.
(audience laughs)
Last place anyone looks.
Now it's the modern day,

cues.zh: 所有那些被我们抢过东西的国家
cues.en: and all them countries we stole stuff from

cues.zh: 都在要求归还他们的东西。
cues.en: are asking for their stuff back.
But don't be worried.
We're totally saying a blanket no.
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 现在，你们中有几个人坐在那儿，
cues.en: Now, a few of you are sitting there,

cues.zh: 我能看到你们愤怒的表情，
cues.en: I can see your angry faces,

cues.zh: 像是在说“那又怎样？谁捡到归谁，闭嘴。”
cues.en: like "So what? Finders keepers, shut up."
And-- (audience laughs)

cues.zh: 听着，替你们说句公道话，“谁捡到就是谁的，闭嘴”
cues.en: listen, in your defense, "finders keepers, shut up"

cues.zh: 这招到目前为止对我们一直挺管用的。
cues.en: has worked very well for us so far.

cues.zh: 绅士们这么干，而且干得相当漂亮，
cues.en: Gents does and knocked it out of the park
"finders keepers, shut up".

cues.zh: 但就算是你也得承认，对吧，
cues.en: But even you got to admit, right,

cues.zh: 如果有人偷了你个人的东西，
cues.en: if someone stole something off you as an individual,

cues.zh: 那是你最心爱的东西，结果被他们顺走了，
cues.en: it was your favorite thing and they nicked it,

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，你还知道是谁偷的，
cues.en: and you knew who had nicked it by the way

cues.zh: 这是事实，不是直觉，你确切知道是谁偷的。
cues.en: for a fact, not a hunch, you know who's stolen it.

cues.zh: 所有人都知道，这是人尽皆知的常识。
cues.en: Everybody knows, it's common knowledge.

cues.zh: 甚至还有人专门写书讲过这事。
cues.en: Some people have written books about it.

cues.zh: 他们绝对是从你这儿偷走的。
cues.en: They have definitely nicked it off you.
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 你去讨要，他们就直挺挺站在那儿。
cues.en: You go to ask for it back, and they just standing there.
They're not even running away.

cues.zh: 而且块头是你的两倍大，他们一点都不怕。
cues.en: And they're twice your size, they ain't scared.

cues.zh: 他们甚至都懒得把它藏起来。
cues.en: They haven't even bothered to hide it.

cues.zh: 他们反倒没藏，而是把它供了起来。
cues.en: They've done the opposite of hiding it actually.

cues.zh: 他们把它放进了玻璃展示柜里。
cues.en: They put it in a glass display case.
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 从七个角度打光，一目了然。
cues.en: It's lit from seven different angles, real clear what it is.

cues.zh: 无可辩驳，这就是同一件东西，
cues.en: There's no disputing it's the same thing

cues.zh: 曾经属于你，因为旁边有块铭牌，
cues.en: that once belonged to you cause there's a plaque next to it,

cues.zh: 铭牌顶部写得清清楚楚是什么，
cues.en: says exactly what it is at the top of the plaque,
and then a paragraph underneath

cues.zh: 讲它对你们和你们的文化有多重要。
cues.en: about how important it is to you and your culture.
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 你完全有理由想：“嗯，我确信
cues.en: You'd be forgiven for thinking, "Mmm I'm pretty sure
"they haven't got a leg to stand on here.
(audience laughs)
"Probably gonna take this home today."

cues.zh: 那些国家当初索要文物时，
cues.en: Must have been so confident, all them countries
when they asked for their stuffs back.

cues.zh: 走到英国面前，对朋友说：
cues.en: Walking up to Britain, saying to their friends,
"Wait in the car, don't even need ya.
"Be back in a jiffy mate.
"Hey man, a while ago, a lot of your ancestors

cues.zh: “从我祖先那儿偷了一大堆东西。
cues.en: "stole loads of stuff from my ancestors.
"Yeah, I'm here to take them home.

cues.zh: “咱们把这事儿摆平，你觉得怎么样？”
cues.en: "Let's right this wrong, what do you say?"

cues.zh: 他们肯定以为开门的英国人
cues.en: They must have thought the British person at the door

cues.zh: 会说：“没问题，全还给你们。
cues.en: was gonna go, "Absolutely you can have them back.
"We stole them after all."

cues.zh: 结果我们却说：“恐怕不行。
cues.en: But instead we went, "I don't think so.
(audience laughs)
"We're still looking at it.
(audience laughs and cheers)
"Yeah, just looking at it these days.
"And there's a lot of other people who haven't seen it yet
"we'd quite like to show it to.

cues.zh: “所以现在不行，你这人太自私了。
cues.en: "So not right now selfish.
(audience laughs)
"Don't sulk about it.

cues.zh: “听着，大家都是朋友，别伤和气。
cues.en: "Look, it's no hard feelings mate.
"Hey, you can look at it, come on in.
"Have a look; have a look.
"Seem familiar?
(evil chortle)
"Stand behind the rope!"
(audience laughs)

cues.zh: 所以大英博物馆才总是那么挤。
cues.en: That's why the British Museum is so busy all the time.
No British people ever go in there,

cues.zh: 里面全是外国人来看自己的东西。
cues.en: it's full of people from abroad looking at their own stuff.
(audience laughs)
Just walking the corridors,
reminiscing about the good old days.

cues.zh: 我猜最后还会明目张胆地抢一把礼品店。
cues.en: And I imagine just openly robbing the gift shop at the end.

cues.zh: 这句算我赢了，你们这帮小痞子。
cues.en: That is one all you punks.
